title: Crazy Woman Gets Into Heated Altercation With Neighbor, Goes Nuts When In Custody
description:
#cops #police #arrest

*Please turn on closed captions to follow along with the video, you can also follow along using the transcript at the bottom of the description*

On September 14th 2022. Officers were called to an apartment complex in Florida in regards to two women who was were involved in a very heated altercation. When officers approached the woman she was acting very erratic and was still in a very hostile state. The officer had to detain her due to how hostile and aggressive she was. This is footage of the events that followed.
